units.title: Fashion icons
topics: 1.1. Study of various personalities (historic and contemporary) associated with fashion, music, art, film, television, politics, etc. who had a unique style that made them popular and had a lasting effect on fashion.
uos: 1.b. Find various personalities (historic and contemporary) associated with fashion, music, art, film, television, politics, etc.
